verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center has a topic on installing, creating and publishing Kimi plugins and skills, which implies an installable plugin ecosystem. Kimi Claw separately documents connecting to Feishu, one specific third-party integration. Both are only index-level headings, with no detail on a browsable directory or on how users add third-party apps. Missing for 10: evidence of a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps/connectors, documented steps for adding connectors to the assistant, breadth of available third-party integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
